features.title: Chat starting screen
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can open the app and see a clear Spanish prompt field and a simple way to begin, even before adding any lands.
verification: On Android and Desktop, open the app with no configured lands and find the question field without assistance.
evidence: Shared reducer tests pass with :shared:jvmTest; :desktopApp:build passes and compiles the shared Compose screen.
Self-verification passes for the implemented shared/Desktop scope; Android verification remains blocked by missing SDK configuration.
features.notes: Implement the shared Compose UI in commonMain. Keep the first screen calm, readable, and focused on asking a question.

features.title: Example questions
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can tap a short example question and see it placed into the chat flow without needing to understand how to phrase a prompt.
verification: Tap an example and confirm that its Spanish text is submitted or ready to submit in the question composer.
features.notes: Use examples drawn from topics actually covered by the approved MVP corpus.

features.title: Structured answer contract
features.user_visible_behavior: The app and answer service agree on a response state for answered, abstained, and needs-land-clarification outcomes, with typed sources and minimal land context.
verification: Validate representative request and response examples against the agreed contract.
features.notes: Define the contract before implementing client/service integration. Keep local land labels out of the payload unless a reviewed use case requires them.

features.title: Service health response
features.user_visible_behavior: The service exposes a health response that lets the app or operator distinguish an available service from an outage.
verification: Request the health endpoint when running the service and confirm its documented success response.
features.notes: The backend is proposed in MasterPlanV3.md but is not present in the current repository scaffold.

features.title: Approved source catalog validation
features.user_visible_behavior: Only catalog entries with approved provenance and required metadata can enter the MVP corpus.
verification: Accept a valid official-source fixture and reject a malformed or non-approved fixture.
features.notes: Keep the MVP corpus curated and manually reviewed; automated discovery is deferred.

features.title: Search reviewed source passages
features.user_visible_behavior: A question retrieves relevant passages from the reviewed corpus with enough metadata to identify the source and its applicability.
verification: Run source-anchored questions and confirm the expected source passage appears in the returned candidates.
features.notes: Start with a measured retrieval baseline before treating candidate thresholds as release gates.

features.title: Generate an evidence-grounded answer
features.user_visible_behavior: For a covered question, the assistant returns a plain-Spanish answer whose material claims are supported by retrieved approved passages.
verification: Evaluate a covered source-anchored question and check each material claim against its cited passage.
features.notes: Never treat the language model as the source of legal facts.

features.title: Abstain when evidence is inadequate
features.user_visible_behavior: For unsupported, stale, conflicting, or insufficient evidence, the assistant clearly says it cannot answer safely and gives an appropriate next step.
verification: Submit out-of-corpus and false-premise questions and confirm they return an abstention without invented legal facts.
features.notes: Critical dates and amounts require especially strong source evidence.

features.title: Submit a chat question
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can enter a question, submit it once, see that the assistant is working, and receive the service response in the conversation.
verification: Submit a question to a local or mocked service and confirm the response appears once in the conversation.
features.notes: Preserve the user's original wording.

features.title: Show answer and abstention states
features.user_visible_behavior: The conversation makes a supported answer visibly different from an abstention and presents the limitation in plain Spanish.
verification: Show one answered and one abstained response and confirm their states and next steps are understandable.
features.notes: Do not use a confident visual treatment to imply legal certainty.

features.title: Inspect cited sources
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can see the source title, relevant location, verification date, and open the official source from an answer.
verification: Open each source card in a sample answer and confirm its link reaches the cited official document.
features.notes: Display critical source excerpts prominently when required by the answer policy.

features.title: Recover from service errors
features.user_visible_behavior: If a request fails or the service is unavailable, the person sees a clear Spanish explanation and can retry without losing the question.
verification: Simulate a timeout and a service error; confirm the question remains available and retry is clear.
features.notes: Do not describe a failed or offline request as an answered one.

features.title: Persist multiple lands locally
features.user_visible_behavior: The app can store zero or more distinct lands on the device and retains them after the app is closed and reopened.
verification: Create two distinct records through the repository boundary and confirm both remain after reopening the app.
features.notes: Choose persistence technology during implementation. Define migration and recovery behavior before a real-user pilot.

features.title: Add a land
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can add a named land and leave unknown attributes unset instead of guessing.
verification: Add a land with only a name and another with known water and production details; confirm both save.
features.notes: Keep setup short; area and notes remain optional pending validation.

features.title: Find a saved land
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can see their saved lands by their chosen names, distinguish similar lands, and reach an add action.
verification: With two saved lands, confirm both are visible and distinguishable; confirm the empty state explains how to add one.
features.notes: Use a simple list rather than a map-first or spreadsheet-style layout.

features.title: Edit a land
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can correct the name or known details of one land without changing another land.
verification: Edit one of two saved lands and confirm the other record remains unchanged.
features.notes: Unknown values remain valid after editing.

features.title: Remove a land
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can remove a land they no longer manage after seeing which record will be removed.
verification: Remove one of two lands and confirm only that land is absent from future lists and requests.
features.notes: Use one simple removal path; decide whether undo is needed during implementation.

features.title: Use minimal land context
features.user_visible_behavior: For a land-relevant question, the app supplies all active lands by default using only the attributes needed for that question.
verification: Inspect a request for a land-relevant question and confirm it contains relevant attributes without names or free-text notes by default.
features.notes: A general question must remain usable when no land is configured.

features.title: Ask which land applies
features.user_visible_behavior: When the answer materially differs between lands, the assistant asks the person to choose the relevant land or lands before giving land-specific guidance.
verification: Use two lands with different relevant attributes and confirm the assistant requests a choice instead of selecting one arbitrarily.
features.notes: Candidate choices come from the local list; preserve the original question through the clarification.

features.title: Show which land context was used
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can tell whether an answer is general, based on all lands, or based on the land they selected.
verification: View general, all-land, and selected-land responses and confirm the scope is clear in plain Spanish.
features.notes: Never imply that land details prove eligibility.

features.title: Explain land data handling
features.user_visible_behavior: Before using land-aware answers, a person can understand in plain Spanish what is saved on the device and what may be sent with a question.
verification: Ask a low-digital-confidence reviewer what is stored locally and what leaves the device after reading the notice.
features.notes: Do not promise backup or confidentiality beyond verified system behavior and provider terms.

features.title: Read and operate the chat comfortably
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can use the chat with enlarged system text, clear control labels, and keyboard or assistive-technology navigation.
verification: Check text scaling, screen-reader labels, keyboard focus, and visible focus on Android and Desktop.
features.notes: Also apply large touch targets, high contrast, and plain Spanish.

features.title: Complete a land form accessibly
features.user_visible_behavior: A person can add or edit a land with readable labels, understandable unknown options, and recoverable validation errors.
verification: Complete and correct a land form using enlarged text and keyboard or assistive-technology navigation.
features.notes: Validate the form with people who have low digital confidence.

features.title: Evaluate land-aware answer safety
features.user_visible_behavior: Changes to retrieval or land context can be checked against reviewed cases for correct sources, safe abstention, and correct land clarification.
verification: Run source-anchored covered, uncovered, mixed-land, unknown-attribute, and false-premise cases; review critical facts against original sources.
features.notes: Set numerical gates only after measuring a baseline.

features.title: Build the Android MVP artifact
features.user_visible_behavior: The MVP can be built as an Android debug APK with shared product UI and behavior.
verification: Run `./init.sh --verify` and install the generated debug APK on an Android device or emulator for a smoke check.
features.notes: iOS is not part of MVP acceptance.

features.title: Build the Desktop MVP artifact
features.user_visible_behavior: The MVP can be built and launched on Desktop with the same shared Compose UI and business behavior.
verification: Run `./init.sh --verify`, launch the Desktop app, and complete one question and one land-management scenario.
features.notes: Adapt layout and keyboard behavior for large windows rather than stretching the phone layout.
